title: Harness Controller Attestation Schema
description: harness-controller-attestation/v1 (SW-1511A-HANDOFF-001 boundary). The producer is the installed Claude Desktop path and the isolated OpenCode adapter path; the consumer is handoff admission and the independent qualification gate. An attestation names the configured route (as gateway counters observe it) and the recipient principal the harness would accept a controller handoff as. Capabilities are explicit: absence, a stale attestation, or a route that is not the configured one remains an unsupported named HOLD -- it is never inferred from a written name or a parent process.

schema.description: The exact contract identity. Anything else is refused.

client_id.description: The harness the attestation is about (for example claude-desktop or opencode).

adapter_kind.description: The transport adapter this harness would accept a handoff over (notification or polling). Absent means unknown, which is a HOLD, never a default.

credential_binding.description: A non-secret reference to how the harness reaches the gateway (for example gateway://host:port). A provider credential value here is a refusal; the attestation never carries a secret.

recipient_principal.description: The principal the server-issued handoff must be addressed to for this harness to accept it. A handoff addressed to another principal is refused.

observed_at.description: When the attestation was produced. A stale attestation (older than the configured max age) is a named HOLD, never silently trusted.

max_age_seconds.description: The freshness window the producer asserts for this attestation.

evidence.description: Actual per-harness real-run evidence (gateway counters observed, exit code, artifact). Never a transport-parity claim.

metadata.description: Non-authoritative annotations. Never a place to smuggle a credential.
